Third-party licenses for the shipped game
=========================================

This folder ships with the game package (next to the executable under game/).
It exists so binary redistribution of third-party code remains compliant when
only the game .exe/.bin is distributed — not the engine source tree.

Keep this folder with any public or commercial game build.

Libraries that require notice preservation in redistributions
-------------------------------------------------------------
MIT:
  jolt_mit.txt
  lua_mit.txt
  imgui_mit.txt
  imguizmo_mit.txt
  imgui_file_dialog_mit.txt
  dirent_mit.txt
  glm_mit.txt
  glad_mit_apache.txt          (also includes Khronos Apache-2.0 notes)
  nlohmann_json_mit.txt
  simple_ini_mit.txt
  miniz_mit.txt
  libsquish_mit.txt
  fast_gltf_mit.txt

BSD-2-Clause:
  dds_ktx_bsd2.txt

Apache-2.0:
  simdjson_apache20.txt        (via fast_gltf)

zlib (notice kept; end-user credit appreciated, not required):
  sdl2_zlib.txt
  mikktspace_zlib.txt

SIL OFL 1.1 + CC BY 4.0 (Font Awesome Free webfont):
  font_awesome_ofl_ccby.txt

SIL OFL 1.1 (Inter):
  shipped with the font at game/engine/fonts/inter/OFL.txt

Public domain / Unlicense (no notice file required to ship)
-----------------------------------------------------------
  miniaudio
  verblib (Freeverb port; not GPL Freeverb3)
  stb_image (PD election)

Not included here
-----------------
  Steamworks SDK — not linked in the current game binary. If Steam is enabled
  later, follow Valve's Steamworks partner / redistributable rules separately.
  Bullet — present under third_party/ but not linked by the current build.

Notes
-----
- The current main executable may still link editor/tooling code in development
  builds; ImGui / ImGuizmo / ImGuiFileDialog notices are included for that reason.
- If a future "game-only" binary drops editor UI, you can remove those three MIT
  files after confirming they are no longer linked.
- This is not legal advice. When in doubt, keep the notices with the build.
